headline: Poland restarts fuel subsidy to stabilize gasoline and diesel prices | International
summary: Poland will restart its CPN fuel price subsidy from August 17 to August 31, with gasoline and diesel expected to fall 0.9 to 1 zloty per liter. The move responds to energy price volatility linked to Middle East tensions.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into inflation and consumer spending, and government subsidies affect fiscal costs and the inflation outlook.
